_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "skeleton_ping" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "observed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "lat" REAL NOT NULL, "lon" REAL NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "sent_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "project" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, "default_crs" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4326, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "taxon_list_version_id" TEXT NULL, "area" TEXT NULL, "server_version" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_queue" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "mutation_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_version" INTEGER NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "retry_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_attempt_at" TEXT NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "habitat_type" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_en" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_sr" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "eunis_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_version" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "management_type" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_en" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_sr" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "server_version" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plant_taxon" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "scientific_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "family" TEXT NOT NULL, "vernacular_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "vernacular_name_en" TEXT NOT NULL, "taxon_source" TEXT NOT NULL, "taxon_source_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "server_version" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "project_protocol" ("project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES project (id), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "protocol_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "survey_method" TEXT NOT NULL, "season_start" TEXT NOT NULL, "season_end" TEXT NOT NULL, "day_start_time" TEXT NOT NULL, "day_end_time" TEXT NOT NULL, "min_temperature_c" REAL NOT NULL, "sunny_temperature_c" REAL NOT NULL, "max_cloud_cover_pct_if_cool" INTEGER NOT NULL, "max_wind_beaufort" INTEGER NOT NULL, "allow_precipitation" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("allow_precipitation" IN (0, 1)), "target_visits_per_season" INTEGER NOT NULL, "max_distance_from_transect_m" REAL NOT NULL, "observation_time_tolerance_min" INTEGER NOT NULL, "gps_interval_s" INTEGER NOT NULL, "gps_interval_battery_saver_s" INTEGER NOT NULL, "gps_accuracy_warning_m" REAL NOT NULL, "gps_gap_s" INTEGER NOT NULL, "high_count_threshold" INTEGER NOT NULL, "min_coverage_pct" INTEGER NOT NULL, "server_version" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_conflict" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "conflicting_fields" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "resolved_at" TEXT NULL, "resolution_note" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "server_version" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transect" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES project (id), "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_length_m" REAL NULL, "habitat_summary" TEXT NOT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "geometry" TEXT NOT NULL, "length_m" REAL NOT NULL, "server_version" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "survey_visit" ("server_version" INTEGER NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES project (id), "transect_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transect (id), "observer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "protocol_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "survey_method" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pollard_walk', "started_at" TEXT NULL, "ended_at" TEXT NULL, "duration_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "paused_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "distance_walked_m" REAL NULL, "observer_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "observer_names" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "temperature_start_c" REAL NULL, "temperature_end_c" REAL NULL, "wind_beaufort_start" INTEGER NULL, "wind_beaufort_end" INTEGER NULL, "cloud_cover_start_pct" INTEGER NULL, "cloud_cover_end_pct" INTEGER NULL, "precipitation" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "weather_suitable" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("weather_suitable" IN (0, 1)), "weather_missing_reason" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "zero_observation_confirmed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("zero_observation_confirmed" IN (0, 1)), "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft', "cancel_reason" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "battery_saver_used" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("battery_saver_used" IN (0, 1)), "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_offline" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("created_offline" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "paused_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (status IN ('draft','in_progress','completed','synced','reviewed','locked','cancelled')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "survey_track_point" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "survey_visit_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES survey_visit (id), "recorded_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "lat" REAL NOT NULL, "lon" REAL NOT NULL, "accuracy_m" REAL NULL, "altitude_m" REAL NULL, "speed_m_s" REAL NULL, "heading_deg" REAL NULL, "provider" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'gps', "sequence_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "server_version" INTEGER NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("survey_visit_id", "sequence_number"), CHECK (provider IN ('gps','fused','network','simulated')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "taxon" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "author" TEXT NOT NULL, "rank" TEXT NOT NULL, "genus" TEXT NOT NULL, "family" TEXT NOT NULL, "vernacular_name_sr" TEXT NOT NULL, "vernacular_name_en" TEXT NOT NULL, "taxon_source" TEXT NOT NULL, "taxon_source_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "photo_required" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("photo_required" IN (0, 1)), "identification_notes" TEXT NULL, "accepted_name_id" TEXT NULL, "introduced_in_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "retired_in_id" TEXT NULL, "scientific_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_version" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "taxon_list_version" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version_label" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "published_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_current" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_current" IN (0, 1)), "notes" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_version" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transect_section" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "transect_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transect (id), "section_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "sequence_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL, "habitat_type_id" TEXT NULL, "management_type_id" TEXT NULL, "geometry" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_version" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX sync_queue_entity ON sync_queue (entity_type, entity_id, seq)
